decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Yes. The manual states that in some cases, when there is good rain, urea application can be done in three phases: 1/3 during planting, 1/3 after 30 days, and the remaining third three weeks after the second application. Your planned total of 150 kg urea per hectare matches the manual's stated rate of 150 kg/ha urea for garlic. Note that this is the fertilizer product mass; the manual separately describes garlic's nitrogen requirement as 70–125 kg N per hectare, with half applied as the crop begins to grow and the remainder split into two to three applications at three-week intervals, and advises not applying N when bulbs begin to enlarge.
